add.speciesPlaceholder: Search by name, number or ID

add.help: It is created with the species' own ability, gender and moves (up to the chosen level), no EVs and a neutral nature. You can fine-tune everything in the editor afterwards.

mode.label: Edit mode
mode.hexHelp: HeX: only allows legal changes according to your game's rules. Link the game folder first.
mode.haxHelp: HaX (default): allows any change with no restrictions.
mode.rejectedBody: This change would introduce illegal values and was not applied. Switch to HaX if you want to do it anyway.
mode.rejectedSaveBody: There are unsaved illegal changes. Undo them, or switch to HaX to save them.
mode.title: Edit mode
mode.hexBody: Does not let you introduce illegal Pokémon or values for your game (species, moves, abilities, ranges…). What the save already had is left alone. It is turned on by hand and works best with the game folder linked.
mode.haxBody: Allows any change: nothing is ever blocked.

warn.title: Turn on HeX mode
warn.intro: HeX rejects changes that would introduce something illegal according to your game's rules. Before turning it on, keep in mind:
warn.needsGame: It depends on the game folder: link it first (in Settings) so PESHeX can read which moves each Pokémon can learn, its abilities, items and stats, and so check whether something is legal.
warn.canFail: It can be wrong in some fangames (randomizer bases, custom mechanics or data): rejecting changes that are actually valid or skipping some rules.
warn.fallback: Without the game folder only basic rules are checked (ranges, duplicates, sizes). If HeX gets in the way, switch back to HaX at any time.
warn.unlinkedTitle: You have not linked the game folder yet
warn.unlinkedBody: Without it, HeX will only apply the basic rules (“partial legality”).

pokemon.totalStatsHint: Computed with the game's formula (base + IV + EV + level + effective nature).
pokemon.totalStatsSavedOnly: Values saved in the file (link the game folder to compute them).
pokemon.totalStatsDiff: The value saved in the file differs from the computed one; "Recalculate stats" makes them match.

zoom.title: App zoom
zoom.help: Enlarges or shrinks the whole interface (50%–200%). It applies instantly and is remembered; the default is 100%.
zoom.autoHelp: Scales the app so that every tab is visible without scrolling, and readjusts when the window is resized or maximized.

game.title: Game folder
game.intro: Link your fangame's folder (the one with Game.ini, Data and Graphics) to see real names, the game's own sprites, searchable pickers, and the rules of HeX mode. It is read-only: PESHeX never modifies that folder.
game.pendingBlock: Save or discard pending changes before changing the game folder.
game.banner: Link your game's folder to see real names and sprites.
game.noGraphics: The folder has no Graphics: placeholders will be shown instead of sprites.
game.encrypted: The game is packed (Game.rgssad): its data and graphics cannot be read. Use the game's development folder.
game.limitsNone: No constants found in the scripts: Essentials defaults are used.

levelHelp.full: HeX rules can check species, moves, abilities, items and stats.
levelHelp.partial: Some rules are not reliable for this game and are skipped (see reasons).
levelHelp.basic: Only basic rules are checked (ranges, duplicates, sizes). Link the right game folder for more.

backups.title: Backups and comparison
backups.subtitle: The copies PESHeX makes when saving, to compare or restore
backups.pendingBody: Save or discard the pending changes to be able to restore a backup. Comparing is always possible.
backups.empty: There are no backups yet. They are created when saving (you can turn this off in Settings).
backups.restoreBody: The current save will be replaced by “{{file}}”. A copy of the current save is made first, so nothing is lost.
backups.pickTitle: Choose the save to compare with

diff.note: Pokémon in the current save: {{current}} · in the other: {{other}}. They are matched by personal ID.

assets.title: Unresolved icons
assets.intro: Some icons do not follow the usual file name and cannot be matched automatically. Pick the file for each species by hand or accept a look-alike suggestion. It is stored on your computer, never inside the game folder.
assets.suggestNote: Suggestions compare the look with the species' battle sprite. Nothing is assigned until you accept it.

firstRun.title: Welcome to PESHeX
firstRun.langBody: Choose the language of the app. You can change it later in Settings.
firstRun.gameTitle: Do you want to add a game folder?
firstRun.gameBody: With your fangames registered, PESHeX keeps them organized, finds their saves and loads their data faster. You can add them now or later from the start screen.

games.title: My games
games.intro: Your fangames, organized: PESHeX finds where each one keeps its saves, lists them without the backup copies, and can preload their data so they open faster. Read-only: it never modifies the game folder.
games.empty: You haven't added any game yet. Add a fangame's folder (the one containing Game.ini, Data and Graphics) to keep it at hand.
games.pickDialog: Choose the game folder (the one containing Game.ini, Data and Graphics)
games.noSavesBody: No saves were found for this game. Choose the folder where it keeps them (usually %APPDATA%\<game name>, or a "Saves" folder inside the game).
games.pickSaveDirDialog: Choose the folder where this game keeps its saves
games.preloadHint: Reads the game's data and stores it so it opens faster next time.
games.removeHint: It only removes it from this list: nothing is deleted from your disk.
games.manage: Manage your games and their saves folders here. To open a save, go to the start screen (Close file).

updater.title: Updates
updater.unsupported: This copy of PESHeX cannot update itself (it is a development build or does not include the updater). Download the latest version from the GitHub Releases page.
updater.readyHelp: The download is verified (SHA-256) and the files are ready. When you install, PESHeX will close, update and reopen by itself.
updater.applyingHelp: Installing… PESHeX will close and reopen in a few seconds.

unsaved.title: You have unsaved changes
unsaved.body: If you install now, PESHeX will close and any unsaved changes will be lost. Cancel, save your file and install again.

result.failed: Version {{version}} could not be installed; the previous one was kept. {{message}}

error.network: Cannot reach GitHub. Check your network and try again; what was downloaded so far is kept.
error.http: GitHub answered with an error. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: GitHub rate-limited requests from your network. Try again in a while.
error.no_release: No version has been published yet.
error.no_asset: The published version does not include the Windows package.
error.no_checksum: The published version does not include the package's SHA-256 checksum: it is not installed, for safety.
error.host_not_allowed: Download address not allowed: files are only downloaded from GitHub.
error.hash_mismatch: The download does not match its SHA-256 checksum (it is corrupt or incomplete). It was discarded; try again.
error.size_mismatch: The download does not have the expected size. It was discarded; try again.
error.bad_archive: The downloaded package is not valid. It was discarded; try again.
error.not_writable: Cannot write to the PESHeX folder (is it in Program Files?) or PESHeX is still open. Move it to a folder of your own, such as Documents or the Desktop.
error.io: Disk error while preparing the update. Check that there is free space.
error.invalid: The version data is not valid.
error.default: The update could not be completed.

updater.logHint: If the problem persists, send the updater.log file: this button opens its folder.
updater.logFailed: The log could not be opened (it doesn't exist yet or access was denied).
